integration.authority: Root SDKWork specs remain authoritative. Local specs may extend but must not contradict them.
integration.dependencyPolicy: Consumes @sdkwork/mall-partner-service and @sdkwork/mall-pc-core; never imports the partner app SDK outside partner-service.ts.
integration.sdkPolicy: The runtime partner service is injected through configureSdkworkPartnerServiceProvider; components never construct SDK clients.
integration.languagePolicy: React 19 function components, hooks with full dependencies, copy from partner-copy.ts.
